subject: PO fields, net terms, and volume-banded discount proposal for IvyTech
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@ivytech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: PO and invoicing questions for Redwood — PO fields, net terms, tiered discounts

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — product looked strong. Procurement is pulling together the paperwork and we want to confirm a few requirements before we send a formal PO. Can you confirm the following:

- PO fields we require on every invoice: PO number, GL code, cost center, Redwood invoice reference and a line-item mapping to subscription SKUs. Is that OK?
- Standard net terms you accept (Net30/Net45/Net60) and whether early-pay discounts are available.
- Invoice cadence: IvyTech prefers consolidated monthly invoices to our central AP team; we do have an option to receive weekly statements but that usually requires a higher processing fee. Can Redwood produce a single monthly invoice grouped by PO?
- Volume/commitment discounts: we are evaluating a $150k first-year commitment and would like to know whether tiered discounts are available (e.g., threshold at $50k, $150k, $300k). If so, how are discounts applied (retrospective credit vs invoice-level adjustment)?
- Multi-entity billing: we have three legal entities that may be covered by a single master agreement. Can you accept split invoices mapped to entity GLs?

I'm attaching our standard PO template for reference (short PDF). If you can send a one-page summary of acceptable PO fields and a sample invoice, procurement will circulate internally and aim to issue a PO next week.

Appreciate it —
Alicia Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
IvyTech Systems
Attachment: ivytech-po-template.pdf (pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO and invoicing questions for Redwood — IvyTech (procurement asks)

Vanessa, Ben — see procurement notes from IvyTech below. They plan to issue a PO if we can confirm acceptable fields, invoice cadence, and a clear discount structure for volume. Quick asks:

- Vanessa: can you confirm our standard support for PO fields, multi-entity billing, and the preferred way to apply volume discounts? Also need your recommended tiers and any processing fee for weekly statements.
- Ben: any finance constraints on Net45 vs Net60 or on retrospective credits vs invoice adjustments? If we provide early-pay terms, what's the typical margin impact?

Goal: respond to Alicia with a concise one-page terms summary + sample invoice and attach our pricing matrix. I can lead the reply once we have consensus.

Thanks —
Rachel
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: PO and invoicing questions for Redwood — IvyTech (pricing/ops proposal)

Rachel / Ben — quick draft guidance below based on our enterprise playbook and recent precedents. Attaching a compact pricing matrix for IvyTech scope.

- PO fields: We can support PO number, GL code, cost center, Redwood invoice reference and SKU-level line-items. We require PO number and remit-to info to route payments. No problem with mapping line items to SKUs.
- Invoice cadence: Standard is consolidated monthly invoice by PO. Weekly statements are supported but we apply a $250/week processing fee (covers AP formatting).
- Net terms: Default Net45 for enterprise contracts. Net30 is available for SMBs; Net60 or longer requires finance approval and credit review. Early-pay: 1% discount if paid within 10 days (1%/10).
- Volume-banded discounts (annualized commitment tiers):
   * Tier A: >= $50,000 annualized — 5% invoice credit (applied monthly as invoice-level discount)
   * Tier B: >= $150,000 annualized — 10% invoice credit (applied monthly)
   * Tier C: >= $300,000 annualized — 15% invoice credit + entitlement to prepay slab pricing
  Discounts are applied prospectively once the threshold is met for the billing period; we also offer a retrospective true-up credit at quarter close if thresholds push them into a higher band.
- Multi-entity billing: We can emit separate invoices per legal entity mapping to their GLs while operating under a single master agreement. Each invoice needs the corresponding PO and remit information.

Constraints / approvals:
- Any Net60 or special early-pay greater than 1% requires Ben/Finance sign-off.
- If IvyTech requests weekly consolidated statements without PO-level detail, require a $250/week fee.

Attached: redwood-enterprise-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx (compact tiers + example invoice lines). If Ben signs off, Rachel you can send a one-page summary to Alicia and attach the matrix + a sample invoice PDF.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-enterprise-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@ivytech.com>, procure@ivytech.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoicing questions for Redwood — PO fields, net terms, tiered discounts

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Per procurement requests and our internal review, here's a concise summary we can confirm today (happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer):

1) PO fields we accept (required): PO number, remit-to address, Redwood invoice reference, GL code, and cost center. SKU-level line items are supported and recommended to map spend.

2) Invoice cadence: Redwood will produce a single consolidated monthly invoice grouped by PO (preferred). Weekly statements are possible but would incur a $250/week processing fee.

3) Net terms & early-pay: Standard is Net45. We can offer Net30 on request. We also offer an early-pay discount of 1% if payment is received within 10 days (1%/10). Net60 or longer would need finance approval.

4) Volume-banded discounts (example bands):
   - >= $50k/year: 5% invoice credit (monthly)
   - >= $150k/year: 10% invoice credit (monthly)
   - >= $300k/year: 15% invoice credit + option for prepay slab pricing
  Discounts are applied to invoices prospectively and we will do a quarterly true-up credit if the annualized spend moves them into a higher band.

5) Multi-entity billing: We can issue separate invoices per legal entity (each mapped to its PO/GL). A single master agreement is fine; each invoice must reference the entity-specific PO.

Next steps:
- If IvyTech is comfortable with the above, please attach your signed PO referencing DEAL-8472 (or include your PO number on the PDF) and indicate whether you prefer monthly consolidated invoices.
- I'm attaching a sample invoice in IvyTech format for your AP review and our pricing matrix for transparency. If you need finance to sign any exceptions (Net60 or different early-pay), Ben is CC'd and can expedite.

Attachments: sample-invoice-ivytech-format.pdf, redwood-enterprise-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx

Would appreciate a short confirmation so procurement can issue the PO.

Best —
Rachel Kim
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
